answer.proposed_action: Retain recording 122398 in denton-tx-health-building-standards-commission without changing official metadata.
answer.rationale: The official agenda linked to recording 122398 explicitly states that the City of Denton Health and Building Standards Commission will convene on June 3, 2021, at 3:00 p.m., matching the supplied recording. Under the approved policy, the officially convened body determines ownership; the Council Work Session Room is only the meeting location. The existing commission feed represents that body and explicitly includes this recording. This supports the recording-specific assignment, not a conclusion about archive completeness.
